```{r load-packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(randomForest)
library(pROC)

options(bdat602.source_only = TRUE)
source("courses/bdat-602/_teacher/resources/datasets/simulate_bdat602_data.R")
health_data <- simulate_bdat602(n = 50000, seed = 602)
```

```{r split-data}
set.seed(602)
idx   <- sample(nrow(health_data), 0.80 * nrow(health_data))
train <- health_data[idx, ]
test  <- health_data[-idx, ]

# Convert target to factor
train$churned <- factor(train$churned, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
test$churned  <- factor(test$churned,  levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
```

## Task 5: Distributed random forest with Spark (eval=FALSE)

```{r task5-spark-setup, eval=FALSE}
library(sparklyr)
library(dplyr)

# TODO: connect to a local Spark session
sc <- NULL  # spark_connect(...)

# Generate and copy the FULL 500,000-row dataset to Spark
options(bdat602.source_only = TRUE)
source("courses/bdat-602/_teacher/resources/datasets/simulate_bdat602_data.R")
health_full <- simulate_bdat602(n = 500000, seed = 602)
health_tbl  <- copy_to(sc, health_full, name = "health_ins", overwrite = TRUE)

# Encode plan_tier as an integer for Spark (Spark cannot auto-encode string columns
# in the same way R does; ordinal coding is fine here since plan tier has a natural order)
health_tbl <- health_tbl |>
  mutate(
    plan_tier_num = case_when(
      plan_tier == "Bronze"   ~ 1L,
      plan_tier == "Silver"   ~ 2L,
      plan_tier == "Gold"     ~ 3L,
      plan_tier == "Platinum" ~ 4L
    )
  )
```

```{r task5-spark-split, eval=FALSE}

test_spark  <- NULL  # splits$test
```
